notes: Born May 9, 1796, Fairfield, New York. Father Levi Wight; mother Sarah Corton. Married Harriet Benton January 5, 1823 in Henrietta, NY. Had 4 wives and 11 children (none named). Led splinter group to Texas after JS death. NOTE: This Lyman Wight (1796-1858) is a DIFFERENT person from Lyman Wight (1829-1896) who appears in Boyd K. Packer's line. No connections to apostle families found.
